_meta.description: Demo portal registry aligned to module 002-portal-routing.

admin.label: Admin Portal
admin.description: Run hiring operations, applicant review, pipeline management, and recruiter workflows.
admin.heroTitle: Hire faster with one connected operations surface.
admin.heroDescription: Applicants, interviews, evaluations, documents, and templates stay coordinated from one route-aware admin workspace.
steps: Review live hiring KPIs and funnel health before the standup.
Move candidates across interviews, evaluations, and offer stages.
Keep templates, documents, and settings aligned with the recruiting process.

candidate.label: Candidate Portal
candidate.description: Track applications, interviews, documents, onboarding, and messages from HR.
candidate.heroTitle: See every application step without guessing what comes next.
candidate.heroDescription: Timelines, interviews, documents, onboarding, and recruiter messages all stay in one personal workspace.
steps: Follow live progress from application review through offer and onboarding.
Book interviews, sign required paperwork, and keep deadlines visible.
Ask HR questions without leaving the same candidate workspace.

client.label: Client Portal
client.description: Review projects, invoices, files, working hours, support, and active contracts.
client.heroTitle: Stay close to delivery, budget, and support from a single client hub.
client.heroDescription: Projects, invoices, time tracking, files, support tickets, and contract status remain visible in real time.
steps: Review project health, milestones, and team activity in one place.
Keep invoices, working hours, files, and contracts synced to delivery.
Reach delivery leads quickly through messaging and support routes.

crm.label: CRM Portal
crm.description: Manage contacts, lead stacks, outreach, scoring, and the active sales pipeline.
crm.heroTitle: Prioritize leads, outreach, and scoring from one revenue cockpit.
crm.heroDescription: The CRM surface groups pipeline movement, hot leads, outreach analytics, template operations, and lead scoring together.
steps: Track contacts, pipeline velocity, and stale deals across active campaigns.
Coordinate templates, lead stacks, and scoring criteria without context switching.
Review closed-won, closed-lost, and operational settings from the same portal.
